title: Chintamani Library v2.3.0 (Build 34) — Instant Update Detection on Every App Launch
releaseNotes: Fixed Update Detection: Update dialog now appears immediately on every cold launch (from splash screen) — no longer requires navigating to Dashboard first
Force Update on Splash: For critical releases with forceUpdate enabled, the install prompt appears within 1 second of app opening regardless of auto-check settings
Ultra-Fast Resumable Downloads: HTTP Range requests and stream resuming — downloads never stall or get interrupted at 45 MB
High-Speed Architecture-Specific Downloads: Automatic arm64-v8a detection cuts download size from 85 MB to 35 MB (2.5x faster!)
Rebranded Universal QR Portal: Standardized all branding to 'Chintamani Library' across headers, titles, cards, and modals
8-Card Luxury Portal Grid: Glassmorphism + multicolour 3D styling with emerald, gold, amber, rose, ruby, purple, cyan and blue accents
Multi-Identifier Attendance: Check in using Mobile Number, Full Name, OR Member ID — any of the three works
Fixed Attendance Fetching: Portal now strictly shows verified real-time records with no fake placeholder data
